description:
Ready for Your Next Adventure

From weekend trail rides and beach cruising to daily commutes, the E03 is engineered to deliver unmatched power, traction, comfort, and range.

1500W Peak Power

Take on city streets, steep climbs, and rugged trails effortlessly. Enjoy exhilarating acceleration and unwavering performance for your daily commute or wild weekend escapes.

48V 17.5Ah Removable Battery

Unlock up to 60+ miles of pedal-assisted exploration. The removable design makes it easy to pop out and charge conveniently anywhere—at home, the office, or on the go.

26" x 4.0" All-Terrain Fat Tires

Pavement is just the beginning. Glide over sand, snow, gravel, and dirt trails with massive fat tires that deliver unshakeable traction, stability, and a dramatically smoother ride.

Full Suspension Comfort

The heavy-duty high-carbon steel frame safely supports up to 396 lbs. Paired with a premium dual-suspension system and an ergonomic seat, you'll absorb the harshest bumps with ease.

Intuitive Smart Tech

Command your ride with a vibrant LED color display, cruise control, and dual mechanical disc brakes. Complete with a brilliant front headlight and horn for confident night riding.

SGS & UL 2849 Certified

Your safety is our top priority. The E03's electrical system is fully certified to rigorous safety standards. Enjoy total peace of mind with our comprehensive 1-year warranty on core components.
